name: get-pull-request
description: Gets a GitHub pull request by number with a summary of its changes: state, branches, reviewers, commit and line counts, and each changed file's path, status and line counts (not the patch). The number comes from github__list-pull-requests or github__search-issues-and-pull-requests, the owner and repository from github__list-my-repositories.

owner.description: The repository's owner, the part before the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.

repo.description: The repository's name, the part after the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.

pullNumber.description: The pull request's number; github__list-pull-requests or github__search-issues-and-pull-requests answers it.
